en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Khalid Bin Jareer, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘An oath is not allowed regarding the permission of a Prophibition, nor for prohibiting of a Permissible, nor for cutting-off of a relationship’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Khalid ibn Jarir from abu al-Rabi’ al- Shamiy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not permissible to take an oath to make an unlawful matter lawful, a lawful matter unlawful or to cut off good relations with relatives.’”
